name: Afrobeat Horns
description: Horns for Afrobeat: short stabs and sustained notes on trumpet and tenor trombone, an alto sax, and a Horn Section patch that plays trumpet, sax and trombone (an octave down) together.

patches.name: Trumpet Stab
patches.note: Staccato trumpet (VSCO 2 CE). 3 velocity layers x 2 round robins. Each press plays the whole recorded stab whatever the note length.

patches.name: Trumpet Sustain
patches.note: Sustained trumpet (VSCO 2 CE), 2 velocity layers, looped in the steadiest part of each note.

patches.name: Trombone Stab
patches.note: Staccato tenor trombone (VSCO 2 CE). 4 velocity layers x 2 round robins, played to the end of the recording.

patches.name: Trombone Sustain
patches.note: Sustained tenor trombone (VSCO 2 CE), 3 velocity layers, looped in the steadiest part of each note.

patches.name: Alto Sax
patches.note: Alto saxophone, condenser microphone (Weresax). 2 velocity layers x 2 round robins, sustained notes looped in their steadiest stretch.

patches.name: Horn Section
patches.note: Trumpet and trombone stabs with the alto sax. The trombone sounds an octave below what you play. Play chords for a section.
